purpose: Discover and verify individual apartment asking listings. Never label as project range, ASP, deal, or latest developer sale price.

targets.source_scope_note: Apartment-only Rever project listings. Require listing detail project match, original dated update <90 days and two independent hosted checks; never aggregate into project ASP.

discovery_note: Project-specific apartment sale catalogs only. Each independently verified listing must identify the exact configured project on its own detail page, have an explicit publisher-updated date no older than 90 days and match in two GitHub-hosted runs at least one hour apart. Ads remain individual asking offers, never price-history trend or project ASP.
